tacticalIdentity: Gravity and force specialist. Pulls high-value targets into kill zones, immobilizes with Gravity Wells, and crushes isolated units with concentrated gravitational force. Peak value from coordinating pulls with Toximancer TOXIC_TERRAIN or Pyromancer ON_FIRE zones.
designNotes: Pull mechanic is the core kit identity. Gravity Well creates a persistent pull zone. Crush is the highest single-hit damage in the physical tier.

baseSpells.description: A focused gravity projectile dealing 15 damage and applying WEIGHTED to the target (movement range -2, 2 turns). Units under WEIGHTED cannot be displaced by wind or water spells.
baseSpells.designNotes: No-cooldown damage plus WEIGHTED. Slows pursuit and escape. Pairs with Thermal Gradient Zone crossing denial.

baseSpells.description: Applies focused gravitational force to a single target, pulling them 3 tiles toward the Gravimancer. Pull chain: if the pulled unit impacts another unit, both take 8 collision damage.
baseSpells.designNotes: Core displacement. Pulls target into TOXIC_TERRAIN, ON_FIRE, or melee range of allied Mancers. Collision chaining stacks damage.

baseSpells.description: Creates a persistent gravity anomaly at a ground target. Units within 3 tiles of the Well are pulled 1 tile toward it at the start of each turn. Units cannot voluntarily move away from the Well without spending 2 extra AP. Duration: 3 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Persistent pull zone. Combined with TOXIC_TERRAIN at the center, creates a passive death trap. THERMAL SHOCK trigger for Thermomancer midline crossing.

baseSpells.description: Directs gravitational force to compress a single target, dealing 40 damage. Target is STUNNED for 1 turn and forced to the ground (removes elevation advantage). Heats target due to compression. Cannot affect constructs (Bone Spires, Crystal Nodes).
baseSpells.designNotes: Signature heavy. 40 damage + STUN + elevation removal. Removes Geomancer Raise Terrain advantage.

baseSpells.description: Stabilizes an allied unit's gravitational signature, making them immune to all displacement and knockback. Ally gains +2 physical armor while anchored and can ignore movement cost penalties from terrain. Duration: 3 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Anti-displacement protection. Synergizes with Geomancer Earthen Mantle on adjacent allies for a locked formation.
